# `Client`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Guest-mode client list, personalized per recipient with whether that socket is the master.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, socket_json_server::guest_mode_notify @0x6b40c0, print_cli_connection @0x6b2a50, print_cli_is_master @0x6b3f10; guider guest_mode_notify @0x117c60 (64-bit builds) |

Sent through the guest-mode notifier when guest-mode connections, the master or client names change; no timer. Only sent while guest mode is on, and only to eligible clients (a per-connection client-info flag can skip entries), each copy personalized with is_master. Emitted by the imager on TCP 4700 (channel I) and by the guider on TCP 4400 (channel G); guider event lines reaching the imager are forwarded onto 4700 unchanged (except in the auxiliary process). Family: custom; no state or error. No client UUID or MAC member is asserted. APK consumers: the app event dispatcher; the app device service client handler.

Side effects: Observation only.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"Client"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `connected` | array<string> | yes | - | Eligible client names, ordered by copied connection index. [READ] |
| `master_index` | integer | yes | - | Index of the master in connected; a negative sentinel when no entry matches. [READ] |
| `is_master` | boolean | yes | - | Whether the receiving socket is the master; differs per recipient. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, two-clients - READ shape, not captured; values invented:

```json
{"Event":"Client","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","connected":["Phone A","Tablet B"],"master_index":0,"is_master":false}
```
